build_fuzz_target: build a zstd fuzz target with sanitizers and coverage flags using the build command
run_libfuzzer: run a libFuzzer fuzzer on a zstd target with corpora and artifact directories
run_afl_fuzz: run an AFL fuzz job on a zstd target with input corpora and output directory
generate_seed_corpus: generate a seed corpus for a zstd fuzz target using decodecorpus and zstd binaries
run_regression_test: run regression tests on one or more zstd fuzz targets using libregression.a
